extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.
NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sets material requirements for equipment used in H2S-containing oil and gas production.

API 6A product specification level (PSL 1 to 4) sets the inspection, testing and traceability applied; PR1 and PR2 are the performance requirement levels, PR2 having passed API 6A design-validation testing. PSL 3G adds a gas test.

faqs.q: What is a 100 m³/h centrifugal well-test transfer pump used for?
faqs.a: A well-test transfer pump moves liquid between tanks and vessels on a well-test spread. This single-stage centrifugal pump is rated 100 m³/h, with FRP-lined carbon steel wetted parts and a diesel drive on a skid.

faqs.q: What does single-stage centrifugal mean on this transfer pump?
faqs.a: Single-stage centrifugal means one impeller stage adds the head, giving high flow at moderate pressure. This pump is rated 100 m³/h.

faqs.q: What pump types does the transfer pump family include?
faqs.a: Membrane, progressive cavity, multistage centrifugal and reciprocating variants are available under the same family. Choose by the fluid, viscosity and pressure; state them on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What drive options does the 100 m³/h transfer pump have?
faqs.a: The listed pump has a diesel drive with a manual or pneumatic PTO clutch, in CAT, Cummins, Deutz, Detroit Diesel or Volvo Penta engines. Electric variants with AC or DC and VFD speed control are available.

faqs.q: What flow rate does the transfer pump give?
faqs.a: The pump is rated 100 m³/h. The listing does not state a head or pressure, so give the required head and suction conditions on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What are the wetted parts of the transfer pump made from?
faqs.a: Wetted parts are FRP-lined carbon steel as standard, and full stainless and PTFE-interior variants are available for more corrosive fluids.

faqs.q: Which certificates apply to the transfer pump?
faqs.a: The listing does not state a certificate for the transfer pump. State the approvals your site requires on the RFQ and we confirm them on the quotation.

faqs.q: What does the well-test transfer pump connect to?
faqs.a: It connects between tanks and vessels such as the surge tank, through suction and discharge hoses or piping. See the [surge tank](/c/wt-surge-tank) shelf and the [well testing equipment guide](/blog/surface-well-testing-equipment).

faqs.q: How is the diesel-driven transfer pump started and engaged?
faqs.a: The diesel engine drives the pump through a manual or pneumatic PTO clutch, so engage the clutch after the engine is running. Prime the pump before starting.

faqs.q: Skid, trailer or truck-mounted transfer pump: which one?
faqs.a: The listed pump is skid-mounted; skid, trailer and truck-mounted versions are offered. Choose the skid for a fixed spread and a trailer or truck for mobile work.

faqs.q: Can the 100 m³/h transfer pump be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide on its skid. Give the destination and the engine make and we confirm freight and lead time.

faqs.q: Do you stock the 100 m³/h well-test transfer pump in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the 100 m³/h well-test transfer pump in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the drive type and mounting through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
